messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Spatio-temporal model using CAR prior
parts: On 26 January 2014 17:45, Håvard Rue <hr...@math.ntnu.no> wrote:

On Sat, 2014-01-25 at 06:10 -0800, Gregor Gorjanc wrote:
> Hi,
>
>
> Is it possible to fit spatio-temporal model using the CAR prior? I
> understand how to do the individual components, but not sure how to
> couple them.

yes, at least you can do separable model using the 'group'-feature, so

        f(idx, model="besag", group=time,
              control.group = list(model="ar1"))

f.ex. where time is 1, 2, ....

​Works like a charm. Just to be sure. The produced ID of a latent field follow the order of levels(idx) within levels(time), right?

There are other ways to introduce dependence in time starting from the
'besag' model, but that would require to define these yourself using
'generic'

​How would then one link the different hyperparameters​ with the precision matrix elements? 

​Regards, Gregor​
